title: fix: i18n compliance, auto row selection, column density, border contrast
body:
Grid/list/data-table had ~20 hardcoded English strings bypassing i18n, no auto-selection when bulk actions were defined, oversized index columns, and low-contrast row borders.

### i18n

- **data-table.tsx**: All 12+ visible strings (`"No results found"`, `"Sort ascending"`, `"Hide column"`, `"Cancel All"`, `"Save All"`, `"Export CSV"`, `"Add record"`, `"Open"`, `"Search..."`, etc.) now route through `t()` with fallback defaults
- **ListView.tsx**: `"Hide fields"`, `"Show all"`, `"Share"`, `"Print"`, `"Pull to refresh"`, `"Refreshing…"` → `t()` calls
- **en.ts / zh.ts**: Added corresponding keys to both locale files

### Row selection auto-enable

When `batchActions`/`bulkActions` are defined but no explicit `selectable` is set, ObjectGrid now auto-enables `selectionMode: 'multiple'`:

```tsx
} else if (hasBulkActions) {
  selectionMode = 'multiple';
}
```

### Column width & density

- Selection checkbox + row number columns: `w-12` (48px) → `w-10` (40px)
- Frozen column offset calculations updated to match

### Border contrast

- Row borders: `border-border/50` → `border-border`

### Bug fix

- Filler row `colSpan` was missing `showRowNumbers`, causing misaligned ghost rows when row numbers were enabled

> <issue_title>Airtable UX Polish: Table Selection, i18n, Layout, and Density Fixes</issue_title>
> <issue_description>ObjectUI's current table/grid experience is visually advanced but falls short of true Airtable-level UX in several areas. This issue tracks a set of UI/UX optimizations required to narrow this gap.
> 
> ## Problem Areas:
> 
> 1. **Internationalization (i18n) Gaps**
>    - Mixed Chinese/English in navigation, breadcrumbs, toolbar, and grid headers/controls.
>    - Action: Route all surface-visible strings through the i18n engine. Eliminate hardcoded text.
> 
> 2. **Missing Table Row Selection Feature**
>    - Bulk actions (e.g., "Send Email") are present, but users cannot select multiple rows (no row checkboxes).
>    - Action: Add a standard row selection checkbox column when bulk actions are defined for the table view.
> 
> 3. **Pagination Footer & White Space**
>    - Excessive blank space appears between data rows and the pagination footer when data is sparse.
>    - Action: Anchor pagination directly below the last row or fill empty space with ghost rows for consistent density.
> 
> 4. **Column Width/Alignment Issues**
>    - Index ("#") and icon columns too wide; data columns too compressed.
>    - Action: Use minimal/fixed width for index, flexible for main data columns.
> 
> 5. **Header Spacing Consistency**
>    - Header utilities crowded against the screen edge; misaligned with the app shell.
>    - Action: Align navbar paddings to match grid/container width.
> 
> 6. **Border & Cell Contrast**
>    - Table/grid cell borders too subtle versus Airtable. Makes scanning rows/columns harder.
>    - Action: Enhance the border-color contrast or respect 'bordered' prop more aggressively for denser tables.
> 
> ## Reference
> - [Airtable Reference Screenshot](image1)
> - [Current ObjectUI Demo Screenshot](image2)
> 
> ## Acceptance Criteria
> - Pure i18n compliance (no visible raw strings)
> - Multi-row selection & bulk action workflow
> - Table always feels visually "anchored" to data, not viewport
> - Proper cell/border balance for both light/dense modes
